claims: Continue invasive mechanical ventilation with current settings (P-CMV, PEEP 5, FiO2 40%) and monitor airway pressures, tidal volumes, and oxygenation.
Monitor coagulation status closely (INR, PTT, fibrinogen, platelet count) given coagulopathy and recent alteplase administration.
Repeat comprehensive metabolic panel and liver enzymes to trend severe transaminitis and assess hepatic function.
Monitor serum lactate and acid-base status with repeat arterial blood gas to assess resolution of lactic acidosis.
Assess and manage agitation/delirium with current sedation (midazolam, fentanyl) targeting Richmond-RAS -1 to -2, and monitor CAM-ICU.
Monitor blood glucose closely and manage hyperglycemia with insulin as ordered.
Monitor renal function (creatinine, urine output) and electrolytes given acute kidney injury.
Replete magnesium and monitor electrolyte levels (potassium, calcium, phosphate).
Perform chest imaging (e.g., chest X-ray) to assess pulmonary status and line positions.
Maintain hemodynamic monitoring via arterial line and central venous pressure, with vasopressor support as needed.
